gloss_en: "Eden — no eye has seen it" (עֵדֶן עַיִן לֹא רָאֲתָה, per Berakhot 34b on Isaiah 64:3): the concealed supernal Eden utterly beyond perception, identified in Likutey Moharan 8 with the light hidden away for the future and with prayer — not the earthly Garden of Eden, nor any other sense of 'eden' (delight/pleasure)
